summary: The figure shows the age-standardized prevalence of current tobacco use among persons aged 15 years or older across WHO regions and globally for the years 2000 and 2020. Tobacco use prevalence decreased in all regions and globally from 2000 to 2020 for both sexes, males, and females. The South-East Asia Region had the highest prevalence in 2000 for both sexes and males, while the African Region had the lowest prevalence for females in both years. Males consistently show higher tobacco use prevalence than females across all regions.
